subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: Near-Death Experiences
description: Learn Near-Death Experiences in one minute.

hook.text: Tunnels of light, deceased relatives, a feeling of peace—near-death experiences match across cultures.

buildup.text: About 10% of cardiac arrest survivors report NDEs. The experiences are vivid, consistent, and life-changing.

discovery.text: NDEs mirror mythic descents: crossing a boundary, meeting guides, and returning transformed.

twist.text: Neuroscience links NDEs to oxygen deprivation. But knowing the mechanism doesn't erase the meaning people find.

climax.text: NDEs show myths aren't just stories. The brain may generate the same journey structure when facing death.

punchline.text: The brain dies the way myths describe.

quiz.question: What percentage of cardiac arrest survivors report near-death experiences?
